[SWS_DM_01099] Debouncing parameters from DEXT
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04068
⌈
If Debouncing parameters are present in DEXT and Debouncing Algorithm is fitting
(i.e. Timer Based or Counter based), DM shall refer to the DEXT values as given in the
requirements below and ignore any values derived from Monitor Constructors.
⌋
